name: Repo Hygiene
description: Small bookkeeping tools for coding and research jobs. Shipped with the deployment as a worked example of a plugin manifest.

tools.name: note
tools.description: Record a short note in the run's output. Takes `text` and returns it prefixed, so a run can leave a marker a person can grep for.

tools.name: checklist
tools.description: Render a checklist from a list of items, so a run can state what it intends to do before doing it.

config.template:
{% for item in items %}- [ ] {{ item }}
{% endfor %}
